title: Run the Emergency Access Drill

baselineAuthority.ownerDecision: Retain the current pin; re-pin proposal deferred.
baselineAuthority.proofRule: Emergency access functionality is human operational proof. No machine artifact may pretend to perform the sign-in or administrative validation.
baselineAuthority.monitoringRule: Review sign-in/audit evidence for every drill. Confirm configured alerting when an alert path exists.

verifiedSources.title: Manage emergency access admin accounts
verifiedSources.purpose: Emergency-account guardrails, monitoring, secure workstation guidance, and validation at least every 90 days.

authoringReviewNotes: Use a designated secure workstation or Privileged Access Workstation for the drill; do not instruct administrators to use an intentionally untrusted or unmanaged endpoint.
The drill proves real sign-in and administrative access. A recent unrelated emergency-account sign-in is not automatically a recorded drill.
Alert confirmation is conditional on a configured alert path; lack of alerting is a separate hardening gap, not fabricated proof.
integrationGaps: IAMAI can store the operator-entered proof date/result, but the drill itself remains interactive human evidence.
If IAMAI cannot distinguish a scheduled drill from an unrelated emergency-account sign-in, it must not infer the drill is complete from sign-in logs alone.

notes: The human emergency-access drill was not executed during authoring.
